title: GasNetSim_4Qgis: An Open-Source 3D Geospatial Digital Twin Framework for Regional Gas Transmission and Hydrogen Blending
description: A high-fidelity geospatial and thermo-fluid-dynamic digital twin plugin for QGIS coupling GIS vector processing with the GasNetSim matrix solver. Supports 3D geodesic elevation modeling (DEM), explicit Chen (1979) friction transitions, full GERG-2008 real-gas thermodynamics (ISO 20765-2), and multicore parallel simulation of large-scale hydrogen blending roadmaps.
